diagnosis: The failing reference (Phase 1.20 early8__sched_bmm_B40, w85__r01_f01) was a single smoke-test run produced with multi-threaded BLAS; the gate ran with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.

Against Phase 1.20 early8__cov_then_misfit_B40 on the same run (produced with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1), the Phase 1.21 Candidate-B trajectory is identical up to query index 40, exactly where the two rules are designed to differ; the early-start seed rule and the B8-B39 coverage phase are therefore reproduced exactly.
Against the smoke reference the first difference is at query index 44, where BOTH rules are plain margin: a near-tie resolved differently by floating-point noise.

Re-running the Phase 1.21 runner for that case with multi-threaded BLAS (the smoke test's environment) reproduces the smoke checkpoint bit-identically: queried indices identical = True, metrics identical = True.
resolution_status: PASS - runner logic identical; results depend on BLAS thread count only through rare near-ties
consequence_for_phase_1_21: every replication run of every policy uses OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; this environment is frozen in the protocol
